scope: Windows/Linux viewer; SDL2 default, SDL1 conditional; OpenGL/Zink reference retained. DiligentCore selected. Site mapping does not alone certify source completeness.

records.title: Process backend, startup, feature identity and failure
records.responsibility: Resolve process backend before any GL initialization; separate GL recommendations and capabilities from Vulkan queried requirements; initialization failure must precede publication of renderer resources. Selection actually runs before initWindow via LLAppViewer::init; do not persist LastGraphicsRendererFamily as OpenGL for a Vulkan session. Hardware benchmark, GL version/vendor feature masks, diagnostics and GPU identity require backend implementations.

records.title: Native window, context, present, resize and platform handles
records.responsibility: Separate OS input/window ownership from GL context creation; native HWND and SDL2/X11 handle ownership, zero extent suspension, producer shutdown and submitted-work retirement. Explicit GraphicsAPI::Vulkan factory admission creates a real Win32/SDL2 window without GL; legacy use_gl=false remains headless. SDL2 exposes its owned SDL window only in native mode for X11/XCB extraction. Win32 avoids opengl32 loading/context creation and joins native window destruction. The development viewer diagnostic exercises these seams and Diligent presentation/readback; normal UI/chat/world bootstrap remains GL and unimplemented for Vulkan.

records.title: Immediate draw, matrices, texture units and state guards
records.responsibility: Capture complete immutable draw state and view transforms; retain CPU primitive construction; replace GL state scopes/cache invalidation with explicit packet and PSO state. Resource bind calls must carry sampled generation and sampler, never GLuint.

records.title: Vertex/index allocations, updates and draw ABI
records.responsibility: Keep CPU geometry/dirty ranges, snapshot buffer generations and index/attribute formats; allocate/upload through Diligent; completion-retire replacements; preserve packed texture-index bits, normalized colors and joint IDs.

records.title: Base texture interface, images, residency, upload and readback
records.responsibility: Preserve CPU assets, discard policy, alpha/pick masks, stats and fallback images; replace getGLTexture/name API and shared-context upload with backend images, upload requests and generation publication. CPU bytes and readback destinations stay owned through completion.

records.title: Shader assembly, reflection, resource schema and pipeline cache
records.responsibility: Realize linked feature/class/permutation closure into Vulkan GLSL/SPIR-V; explicit view/material/object/pass blocks, shader resources and vertex/attachment ABI; reflect dynamic uniform producers; preserve shader math. GL binary caches are incompatible.

records.title: Render targets, borrowed depth, cube resources and multi-view lifetime
records.responsibility: Explicit attachment ownership/load/store/extent and borrowed-depth contracts; replace implicit target stack; per-face/mip views and transitions; resize generation retirement; retain CPU cube resize fallback where needed.

records.title: UI tree, image primitives, clipping and dynamic drawing consumers
records.responsibility: Preserve virtual widget traversal, paint order, clipping, scale and image/text generations with native ordered packets and immutable Diligent resources. VSUIResources adapts CPU image publication and the LLUIImage draw facade, including masks/nine-slices. Native construction policy guards generic/custom panel and floater factories before allocation/callbacks. Required XUI allowlists, skin image provider, primitive/matrix/nested clip and input integration remain open. Native XUI integration review: scoped primitive/transform/clip and blend adapters publish explicit Diligent packets; CPU skin assets and existing font/widget geometry are collected without GL publication. Closed fixture admission covers corrected mini-progress XUI, line/text editors and their internal widgets. Window character/key/focus dispatch, Tab traversal, scrolling, preedit contract, actual pixels and partial-construction cleanup passed Windows SwiftShader. Login/status/alerts/agreements, general native lifecycle admission, OS DPI and OS IME qualification remain open; legacy GL and world routes remain mapped, not CPU-only, and full G-UI/G-RESOURCE closure is not claimed. Native UI input and guard review: capture-aware window mouse/hover/wheel callbacks target the existing admitted widgets; focus loss cancels capture. Synthetic native events must change editor focus and transcript scroll position. LLRender::begin rejects GL geometry before state mutation while the native owner is active; legacy begin behavior is preserved outside it. Fractional-DPI clip checks preserve the legacy physical-pixel margin. Fifteen Windows SwiftShader cases and actual XUI pixel readback passed. Required login/status/alerts/agreements, additional control states, general native lifecycle admission, OS DPI and OS IME qualification remain open; legacy GL/world routes remain mapped and full G-UI/G-RESOURCE closure is not claimed. Native UI lifecycle and skin review: VSUIContext owns the native image provider, UI root, widget defaults, colors, translations and CPU-backed fonts using borrowed viewer settings and LLDir skin/theme/language overlays. Reusable native UI sources build under USE_DILIGENTCORE independently of diagnostics. The staged runner requires every packaged skin/theme directory and checks selected skin/theme/language identity, XUI readback and input. LLFontVertexBuffer bypasses both GL display-list construction and replay while native publication owns text; ordinary GL caching is preserved. Win32 button-down uses its captured client coordinates rather than a later polled cursor. Windows RelWithDebInfo build/staging and 39 SwiftShader cases passed with zero validation errors. Earlier Linux XUI runs failed through the font GL display list; cross-platform runtime qualification of the correction remains pending. Normal native session wiring, required login/status/alerts/agreements and media dependencies, OS DPI/IME and full G-UI/G-RESOURCE closure remain open. Native viewer-window integration review: LLViewerWindow owns its native device/swapchain, required startup root, login holder, popup/dialog owners, progress controllers, skin-aware UI and resource lifetimes. Normal initWindow dispatch has a native branch; normal LLAppViewer login is now wired; connected-region/session admission remains gated. Native input/reshape routes avoid GL. CPU media buffers and progress images publish immutable Diligent resources; live browser and authentication qualification remain open. Shared translation initialization preserves viewer substitution defaults. Registered specialized factories remain closed while ordinary named panels retain their admitted widget path. Native alert shadows and context cones use explicit triangle packets. Linux primary native font faces retain glyph-generation ownership; cross-platform runtime confirmation is pending dedicated CI. Runtime qualification is recorded separately in viewer-ui-substrate.md; none of these source mappings asserts complete V3, connected UI/chat or world parity. Normal native login integration review: LLAppViewer dispatches ordinary Vulkan configuration into CPU startup services, LLViewerWindow ownership, native frame rendering, browser/event/network pumping and ordered cleanup. The existing idle_startup state machine, FSPanelLogin login_callback, credential handling, required alerts/agreements and LLLoginInstance authentication are retained. Login menus use native-compatible explicit-color primitives. Native startup avoids GL feature recommendation, texture workers and world UI owners. The connected region/chat stage remains explicitly gated before GL world creation with the existing notification/retry path. Windows software qualification covers complete staging, all 44 viewer cases, normal startup, live login browser pixel publication and clean shutdown; real-server authentication, platform-event completeness and connected chat/world parity remain unqualified. V3 completion review: normal native LLAppViewer login lifecycle, skin-aware required login/progress/dialog controls and production plain nearby-chat owner use native UI packets and CPU-only resources. Closed widget/panel/floater admission includes direct browser factories and visible unsupported-action feedback. Native system DPI and SDL composition routes preserve CPU controls; dialogs remain reachable at reduced viewport sizes. General-fence delayed GPU completion verifies exact resource generations survive producer replacement until retirement. Independent actual/expected readbacks use advertised Vulkan subpixel precision with strict color comparison. The expanded matrix covers 68 viewer cases, including required dialog actions and all 24 packaged skin/theme/language selections. Connected transport/region/chat remains V4 work; world parity, real OS IME services and physical multi-monitor DPI are unqualified.

records.title: Font CPU rasterization, lazy glyph creation, atlases and draw buffers
records.responsibility: Retain viewer FreeType metrics, kerning, fallback, emoji and style geometry. Explicit CPU-only atlas backing bypasses LLImageGL allocation/subimage upload; scoped LLFontGL publication sends triangles and CPU atlas generations to VSUIResources. Changed CPU pixels publish only their bounding patch into a fresh Diligent generation. VSUIFontCache separately implements lazy page packing/reuse/reset. Existing GL font defaults remain unchanged; full fallback/style, reset and XUI coverage remains open.

records.title: Media plugin pixels and browser/VLC surfaces
records.responsibility: Keep plugin processes; owned snapshot/producer protocol, dirty rectangles/pitch/channel translation and copy-forward unchanged content; generation-safe resize/teardown. Plugin shared pixels are not Vulkan images.

records.title: CPU scene, cull, LOD, batching and query feedback
records.responsibility: Preserve CPU visibility/cache admission and draw maps; retain snapshot generations; asynchronous query results must not treat unavailable as invisible. Raw debug GL in spatial sources maps additionally to I22.

records.title: Frame scheduler, main/cube/HUD views and pass graph
records.responsibility: Own viewer pass semantics and per-view histories/masks/transforms; main/cube/HUD/startup/snapshot nodes; explicit copies/clear/dependencies; offscreen-only frame retirement. Diligent supplies submission mechanics, not this graph's meaning.

records.title: Draw-pool/material families and glTF scene routes
records.responsibility: Preserve legacy/PBR/glTF material semantics, alpha/mask/unlit/double-sided routes, palette and material/node buffers; complete per-draw PSO/resource state. glTF alpha is independently routed, not automatically PPLL-covered.

records.title: Avatar, rigged attachment, appearance and mesh producers
records.responsibility: Keep CPU animation/morph/palette/LOD and picking data; version vertex/index/palette generations for main/shadow/HUD/impostor/preview views. Local texture objects and layer masks remain CPU-owned until explicit bake/upload contracts.

records.title: Terrain, vegetation, particles, sky and parcel geometry producers
records.responsibility: Retain CPU geometry/particle scheduling/environment semantics; image/geometry dirty outputs become generations; preserve custom particle blends and overlays rather than route all through generic alpha.

records.title: Probes, mirrors, cube-array publication and convolution
records.responsibility: Per-face/mip capture/filter/copy, probe UBO and active-view generation; preserve partial publication/history policy. Divergent subresources cannot use false whole-resource tracked state.

records.title: Transparency, PPLL, water, glow, lighting and post
records.responsibility: Preserve sorted pre/post-water paths; optional PPLL capture/reset/detached depth/resolve/replay/residual order, storage atomics and budget fallback; preserve alpha-as-glow, mixed material encodings and history/post chain.

records.title: Dynamic previews, appearance hints, local bake and CPU consumers
records.responsibility: Every virtual preRender/render/postRender callback emits an offscreen view; appearance hints need serialized scene-state snapshot/restore; bake retains RGBA plus morph mask/five-channel encoding; synchronous consumers need actual completion. LLTexLayer::renderMorphMasks/readback in llappearance/lltexlayer.cpp contains separate Intel fallback glGetTexImage; preserve mask arithmetic/encoding with staged completed transfers, not a renamed GL callback.

records.title: Snapshots, depth, tiled capture and readback consumers
records.responsibility: Capture explicit stage/output/view/tile/UI/HUD/no-post/depth; preserve output encoding/orientation and consumer ownership. CPU principal ray picking stays CPU, with backend-neutral projection and depth tickets where requested. Include LLFloater360Capture::capture360Images -> LLViewerWindow::simpleSnapshot and reflection snapshot; six camera views/multiple render passes plus browser WebGL presentation are different from tiled rawSnapshot.

records.title: HUD/world labels, maps, galleries and ordinary texture UI
records.responsibility: Retain label/map/layout/selection policy, emit ordered view-qualified UI/world glyph/image packets; CPU map raster feeds image upload; 3D HUD attachments are separate view geometry.

records.title: Scene monitor, existing profiling and occlusion facilities
records.responsibility: Preserve sampled stage/freeze/timing policy and query readiness; GL profiler collection must not execute without GL. Development qualification hooks remain excluded from release. Tracy GPU macros currently expand to OpenGL even in non-GL rendering scopes; gate/adapt every GPU macro/context/collect site and TracyOpenGL.hpp inclusion for native Vulkan, retaining CPU Tracy.

records.title: Selection, tools, physics/pathing/debug overlays and callbacks
records.responsibility: Explicit debug draw list/depth/blend/wireframe variants; preserve ordinary tools; non-solid/geometry-shader fallbacks. OS pathing stub is empty; optional binary callbacks accepting LLRender require interface qualification or explicit unsupported Vulkan facility.

records.title: Build, compile features, packages, staging and delivery
records.responsibility: Expose renderer availability separately from dependency presence, link appropriate owned modules, fully stage runtime/assets/shaders/licenses; retain GL/Zink reference; Linux build/package qualification and actual archives/hashes required.

records.title: CPU material/texture interface consumers and indirect rendering callers
records.responsibility: Candidate triage only: each caller must resolve to resource/draw/metric semantics and owned seam. This catch-all does not authorize exclusion or certify review; all sites assigned only I24 remain unresolved.

records.title: Tests, integration fixtures and platform exclusions
records.responsibility: Separate test stubs/fixtures, macOS outside selected Windows/Linux scope, and separately gated headless builds. Must use actual compile gates and path/function evidence, not filename-only exclusion.

records.title: CPU pixel/material/cache producers and genuine namesake exclusions
records.responsibility: LLImageRaw::setSubImage is locked CPU memcpy, not a GPU operation. Fetch/decode/cache/material/texture-entry objects keep CPU policy and bytes; API consumers may trigger backend upload via I05 and are not blanket excluded by type name.

records.title: Compile interface dependency and include-only witnesses
records.responsibility: A #include/forward declaration executes no GPU work; coupling is resolved at the included class/facade definition and all executable statements remain separately catalogued. This is not a CPU-only declaration about the entire includer.

Native Diligent device creation now honors that active CPU session flag so the connected production path loads core/synchronization validation. Diagnostic-only window creation continues to honor the setting directly. No new graphics owner or scene producer; the staged replay verifies loaded validation-layer hashes.

Weak owners and session generations protect seed, event-poll, name, translation and transfer callbacks; bounded reset/logout paths release partial initialization. Native settings and URL admission prevent deferred world/optional producers; native chat/resources remain on Diligent. Diagnostic replay injects protocol fixtures through the production owner and compares actual connected UI readback with the independent CPU oracle. No LLWorld/LLViewerRegion or scene resources are admitted. Live-server and world parity are unqualified; runtime results are recorded separately in viewer-connected-session.md.
